task_a_obligations.focused_result: PASS: 4/4 focused tests passed (1 passed each, 0 failed).

resolver_changes: switch-table length: a relative jump table is now decoded only to the compiler's own bound (`cmp $N, idx` + unsigned-above branch; N+1 entries, N for jae), keyed by the jump address and accepted only when the compare's register is the same register as the table load's scaled index; an unrecognised or mismatched bound keeps the conservative scan. The previous 64 KiB scan read past the table into unrelated .rodata and invented target addresses.

compare suffix: objdump prints a size suffix on memory-operand compares (`cmpq $0,(%rsp)`). The bare-`cmp` test missed it and the generic fall-through treated the compare operand as a store destination, clearing the tracked stack slot at 0x3a12b9.

sites.store_traced: The slot is written at 0x3a125d (`mov %rax,(%rsp)`); %rax was loaded at 0x3a1256 from 0x100(%rax), where %rax at 0x3a124c is `*(group)` (EC_GROUP->meth). Offset 0x100 of the in-image EcMethod layout is `field_sqr`. The slot was lost because `cmpq $0x0,(%rsp)` at 0x3a12b9 was treated as a store and set it TOP; with the compare fix it stays ('field',0x100).
sites.evidence: The four are the only defined data symbols of size 448 in .data.rel.ro in this image; each is a link-time EcMethod table, and the entries at 0x100 are relocation-resolved function pointers. EC_METHOD is opaque in OpenSSL 3.x, so a conforming caller cannot install an external table; the four exported constructors return these tables.
sites.closure_status: Not reachable. Its only referring edge was the switch at 0x379b0c in tls12_client_drive (base 0x64980c, real bound 17 entries); the real table does not contain 0x3a11d0. The old 64 KiB over-scan did. After the bound fix there are zero referrers, so the site does not enter the residual list.

sites.operand: %rax is loaded from 0x8(%r14), i.e. the context field `ctx->hw` (ProvAesGcmSivCtx.hw).
sites.base_recovered: `ossl_aes_gcm_siv_newctx` stores `ossl_prov_cipher_hw_aes_gcm_siv(keybits)` into `(*ctx).hw`; that function returns `&AES_GCM_SIV_HW`, a 32-byte static table at 0x87d550 in .data.rel.ro. Its slot 0 is `aes_gcm_siv_initkey` (0x549dd0), so the target set for this call is {aes_gcm_siv_initkey}.
sites.resolver_limitation: The resolver's field-store summary is keyed by byte offset only. Offset 8 is written with a TOP value by unrelated types, so the summary is open and cannot express 'the constructor of this context installed AES_GCM_SIV_HW at offset 8'. The base was recovered by reading the constructor store and the static table from the exact image, not by the offset-only abstract domain; the rule cannot be encoded without type-aware field tracking, so no invented bound is claimed.

regressions_and_findings: The 64 KiB switch-table scan was inventing reachability: three small compiler tables were decoded far past their bounds and admitted the five sites' containing functions. Bounding the decode to the compiler's own cmp/ja bound reduced the reachable set from the pre-fix reproduction's 354 (ssh) / 343 (sshd) to 316 / 306 and removed all five target-bounded sites. The stricter rule requires the bound compare to use the table's own index register; a table whose bound is not recognisable keeps the conservative scan.
The `cmpq`/`testb` suffix miss was a real resolver defect: a compare of a stack slot cleared the slot, which is why the 0x3a11d0 store appeared open even though it was written in the same frame.

The 0x3a11d0 store is a method-table load, not an object-field store: the four EcMethod tables bound it to their field_sqr entries. The resolver's offset-only field abstraction cannot express that relation; the site is not reachable in this closure.

The 0x54cec0 base is recoverable from the constructor store and the AES_GCM_SIV_HW static table, but the resolver's open offset-8 summary cannot express the constructor/type relation. It is not claimed as a resolver resolution.
The two key2text provider callbacks carried only a vestigial unsafe marker; removing it is an elimination, not a contract.
non_claims: This is not a SAFE_COMPATIBLE promotion and not a mechanism-wide SAFETY_DISCHARGED claim; EVP_PKEY_PROVIDER remains OWNERSHIP_RECONSTRUCTED.

The three caller-supplied callback sites (0x470220 x2, 0x34eb30) are not resolved to a bounded target set and are not claimed to be; they are closed only because the switch-bound correction removes their false reachability in this closure.
The 0x3a11d0 and 0x54cec0 base recoveries are image-level evidence, not a new resolver rule; the tool did not encode them.
Absence of an ASan/TSan report is not a proof of memory safety; the canaries prove the instruments fire, not that the crate has no defect.
The measured V1 OpenSSH binaries do not contain the four legacy-init source fixes; no L4/L7 re-run is offered for this source edit.
